title: He et al. 2025 — VocalMind: A Stereotactic EEG Dataset for Vocalized, Mimed, and Imagined Speech in Tonal Language
description: VocalMind is a stereotactic EEG (sEEG) dataset for speech decoding research in a tonal language, Mandarin Chinese. Intracranial recordings were acquired while a participant produced vocalized, mimed, and imagined speech. The dataset supports research on speech brain-computer interfaces and neural decoding of overt and covert speech. This BIDS conversion includes one subject with three tasks corresponding to the speech modes.
methods_description: Raw per-trial sEEG recordings sampled at 1000 Hz were converted to BIDS iEEG BrainVision format. Per-trial files were concatenated per speech mode/task, with events.tsv marking each stimulus onset.
